# pbs_acls (Data Source)

Lists ACL entries of Proxmox Backup Server for users and API tokens. Group ACL entries are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All ACL entries on a datastore and its namespaces
data "pbs_acls" "store1" {
  path = "/datastore/store1"
}

# Only entries on exactly this path, for one user
data "pbs_acls" "backup_user" {
  path    = "/datastore/store1"
  exact   = true
  auth_id = "backup@pbs"
}

output "backup_user_roles" {
  value = [for a in data.pbs_acls.backup_user.acls : a.role]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_id` (String) Only return entries for this user or API token (`user@realm` or `user@realm!token`).
- `exact` (Boolean) Only return entries on exactly `path`, not on sub-paths. Defaults to `false`.
- `path` (String) Only return entries on this path and, unless `exact` is `true`, below it (e.g. `/datastore/store1`). Omit to list all entries.

### Read-Only

- `acls` (Attributes List) List of ACL entries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))

<a id="nestedatt--acls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acls`

Read-Only:

- `auth_id` (String) User or API token the entry applies to.
- `path` (String) ACL path.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Whether the entry is inherited by sub-paths.
- `role` (String) Role granted.
